title: Recurring team standup
description: Three people: the user (mic), Ana and Ben (far end). Per-person updates, a blocker (staging certificate) settled, a migration reviewer decided implicitly, a carried-over item (offsite venue) never discussed, a livestream tangent.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Morning both. Let's go round quickly. I'll start.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Yesterday I finished the retry logic for the queue worker. Today I'm writing the runbook.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: The retry budget is three attempts, then dead letter, and it is covered by tests now.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: No blockers for me.

utterances.speaker: Ana
utterances.text: Thanks. Yesterday I set up the new dashboard panels for export duration.

utterances.speaker: Ana
utterances.text: The export now takes eighteen minutes, down from almost two hours.

utterances.speaker: Ana
utterances.text: Today I'm tidying the alerts, so we stop getting paged for the cold cache warning.

utterances.speaker: Ana
utterances.text: That's me.

utterances.speaker: Ben
utterances.text: My turn. I'm still blocked on the staging certificate. The renewal request bounced again.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: When does it expire?

utterances.speaker: Ben
utterances.text: Friday morning. After that, staging is down for everyone.

utterances.speaker: Ana
utterances.text: I have admin rights on the certificate portal. I can renew it straight after this call.

utterances.speaker: Ben
utterances.text: That would unblock me completely, thank you.

utterances.speaker: Ben
utterances.text: Apart from that, I finished the migration script, and it's ready for review.

utterances.speaker: Ben
utterances.text: Can someone look at the pull request today?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: I can take it this afternoon. I know that schema well.

utterances.speaker: Ben
utterances.text: Perfect. That's all from me.

utterances.speaker: Ana
utterances.text: Oh, did anyone watch the launch livestream last night?

utterances.speaker: Ben
utterances.text: Only the first ten minutes. My internet kept dropping.

utterances.speaker: Ana
utterances.text: Same, the video kept freezing.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Okay. Anything else before we go?

utterances.speaker: Ana
utterances.text: Just a reminder that the retro is on Thursday afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Ben
utterances.text: And I'm off on Friday afternoon, for a dentist appointment.

utterances.speaker: Ana
utterances.text: Thanks for the heads up.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Noted. Thanks everyone, talk tomorrow.
